selection_basis: All four already active families on a single common pair and their existing one-hour horizon; no selection by observed returns. Historical data was already inspected.
reference_schedule: All issued shared reference epochs in the frozen extract, including missing outcomes and abstentions; no outcome-based resampling.
version_semantics: Recorded predictor implementation and feature contract identities; not an assertion that all rolling training weights are identical.
rolling_prior: Beta(1,1); fallback probability 0.5 until minimum; unique market target events only
probability_target: Reference-to-original-target midpoint return > 0; flat is a separate reported category and a false up label
direction_rule: Preserve the original emitted side for model direction and economic scores; score probability independently. Rolling baseline p_up > 0.5 buys, p_up < 0.5 sells, equality abstains. No optimized threshold.
economic_normalization: 10000 * executable price difference / common entry midpoint; no trade is zero; stress is total extra round-trip bps per non-abstaining decision
target_rule: Original reference epoch plus 3600, never shifted by publication or entry delay
reference_price_rule: Each emitted forecast reference_mid must match the shared original reference quote midpoint within absolute 1e-12; prediction return normalization never moves to the later execution quote.
baseline_cutoff_rule: Strictly before the earliest original issue among the four paired forecasts
missing_clock_rule: Exclude; recorded_utc, row order, file timestamps and data cutoffs are not substitutes for observed availability
graduation: None. Clock-valid engineering scores cannot authorize trading or confirm an edge. A separately registered fresh study is required.
